about_the_game:
The soundtrack of "Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery" includes 65 tracks, each available in both MP3 and WAV formats.
Embark on a journey of fate and choice.
Follow Jefuty, bearer of relic powers, as she navigates the mission "Operation Bakery", relentlessly exploring until she reaches her goal – finding the timeline that allows everyone to survive.
In this arduous journey, music becomes her steadfast companion.
